-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/nexttypes

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/nexttypes/arr"
	"example.com/nexttypes/chanm"
	"example.com/nexttypes/funcr"
	"example.com/nexttypes/gen"
	"example.com/nexttypes/intr"
	"example.com/nexttypes/mapm"
	"example.com/nexttypes/named"
	"example.com/nexttypes/parr"
	"example.com/nexttypes/slice"
	"example.com/nexttypes/str"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(slice.Over([]int{1, 2, 3}), "slice")
	fmt.Println(named.Over(named.S{1, 2, 3}), "named")
	fmt.Println(arr.Over([3]int{1, 2, 3}), "arr")
	fmt.Println(str.Codes("hi"), "str")
	fmt.Println(mapm.Over(map[string]int{"a": 1}), "map")
	fmt.Println(parr.Over(&[3]int{1, 2, 3}), "ptr")
	fmt.Println(gen.Over[gen.S](gen.S{1, 2}), "gen")
	ch := make(chan int, 2)
	ch <- 1
	ch <- 2
	close(ch)
	fmt.Println(chanm.Over(ch), "chan")
	fmt.Println(intr.Over(3), "intr")
	fmt.Println(funcr.Over(funcr.Seq(2)), "func")
}

-- m/slice/slice.go --
package slice

func double(n int) int { return n * 2 }

func Over(xs []int) []int {
	var ys []int
	for i := 0; i < len(xs); i++ {
		ys = append(ys, double(xs[i]))
	}
	return ys
}

-- m/named/named.go --
package named

type S []int

func double(n int) int { return n * 2 }

func Over(xs S) []int {
	var ys []int
	for i := 0; i < len(xs); i++ {
		ys = append(ys, double(xs[i]))
	}
	return ys
}

-- m/arr/arr.go --
package arr

func double(n int) int { return n * 2 }

func Over(a [3]int) []int {
	var ys []int
	for i := 0; i < len(a); i++ {
		ys = append(ys, double(a[i]))
	}
	return ys
}

-- m/str/str.go --
package str

func Codes(s string) []int {
	var out []int
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		out = append(out, int(s[i]))
	}
	return out
}

-- m/mapm/mapm.go --
package mapm

func Over(m map[string]int) []int {
	var out []int
	for _, v := range m {
		out = append(out, v*2)
	}
	return out
}

-- m/parr/parr.go --
package parr

func double(n int) int { return n * 2 }

func Over(p *[3]int) []int {
	var ys []int
	for i := 0; i < len(p); i++ {
		ys = append(ys, double(p[i]))
	}
	return ys
}

-- m/gen/gen.go --
package gen

type S []int

func double(n int) int { return n * 2 }

func Over[T ~[]int](xs T) []int {
	var ys []int
	for _, v := range xs {
		ys = append(ys, double(v))
	}
	return ys
}

-- m/chanm/chanm.go --
package chanm

func Over(ch chan int) []int {
	var out []int
//logos:allow(correctness::unbounded_channel_op)
	for v := range ch {
		out = append(out, v*2)
	}
	return out
}

-- m/intr/intr.go --
package intr

func Over(n int) []int {
	var out []int
	for i := range n {
		out = append(out, i*2)
	}
	return out
}

-- m/funcr/funcr.go --
package funcr

func Seq(n int) func(yield func(int) bool) {
	return func(yield func(int) bool) {
		for i := 1; i <= n; i++ {
			if !yield(i) {
				return
			}
		}
	}
}

func Over(seq func(yield func(int) bool)) []int {
	var out []int
	for v := range seq {
		out = append(out, v*2)
	}
	return out
}
